regulation_clause.text: Closure requests must be honoured within 7 working days (subject to dues); failure incurs a penalty of Rs 500 per calendar day of delay until closure, provided no outstanding.

gold.gold_rationale: Clause 19 requires penalty accrual on a calendar_day basis after the 7-working-day closure window. CLOSPEN1 computes WS-DELAY-DAYS as WS-WORKING-DAYS - WS-SLA-DAYS (line 34), i.e. the delay itself is counted in working days (weekends/holidays already stripped at line 32-33), then multiplied by the ₹500 rate. The implemented day_basis is working_day, not the mandated calendar_day.

prediction.rationale: Lines 32–34 calculate delay using elapsed days minus weekends and holidays, then subtract the 7-day SLA from that working-day total. Lines 35–36 multiply this delay by the penalty rate. The clause specifies Rs 500 per calendar day of delay, so using the working-day total for penalty days conflicts with the stated basis.
